production.prompt: Stormwreck established auburn harpy. True strict LEFT-facing profile in all 8 frames, nose and toes point screen left, preserve anatomical left club and color of reference. Land onto a flat invisible perch, flare wings without fully extending, talons reach down, contact pose 6, settle legs wings and hair 7 and 8. Use the attached game art only for the character's established rendering and identity. Professional animation strip of one creature per cell. 4 columns × 2 rows exactly in chronological order, phase 1–4 on top and 5–8 below. Each creature stays in the center 65% of its own cell with very large transparent gutters, no pose may cross an imaginary cell edge. Wings compact if needed for margin. Fully opaque smooth character silhouettes and a genuinely transparent background, no gradient, backdrop, text, drop shadow, floor, outline or floating marks. All phases same size, costume and anatomy. Wide format 2:1.

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct WEBP phases verified
review.visual: Reviewed for direction, silhouette, clear gutters and identity. Integrated map review recorded separately.
